name: Industrial Centrifuge
notes: GT:NH 2.9 rewrite of the Industrial Centrifuge (structure by Ducked), 5x5x5. Front slice: a ring of Centrifuge Casings the controller looks through. Second slice: the controller in the centre of a 3x3 of Centrifuge Casings, Eglin Steel Frame Boxes on the rim. Two middle slices: 3x3 Large Sieve Grates with a Centrifuge Casing on each side. Back slice: 3x3 Centrifuge Casings framed like the second. Any Centrifuge Casing (at least 6) takes input/output buses and hatches, energy, maintenance and muffler hatches; GT requires energy, maintenance, a muffler, at least one input and one output. Sharing: GT5u adds every hatch it finds during the structure check to that controller's lists with no ownership check, so buses and hatches in a shared wall serve every controller around them; mufflers in a shared wall are shared too, energy and maintenance hatches only when the Share options ask for it. The older GT++ 3x3x3 version is MTEIndustrialCentrifugeLegacy.
